diff_changed.name: Lint all Dockerfiles
diff_changed.diff_after:
--- a/.github/workflows/dockerfile-lint.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/dockerfile-lint.yml
@@ -56,5 +56,5 @@
         run: |
           set -eo pipefail
-          mapfile -t dockerfiles < <(find . -type f \
+          mapfile -t dockerfiles < <(set -o pipefail; find . -type f \
             ! -path './.git/*' \
             ! -path './node_modules/*' \
@@ -62,4 +62,5 @@
             \( -name 'Dockerfile' -o -name 'Dockerfile.*' -o -iname '*.Dockerfile' \) \
             | sort)
+          [ -z "$!" ] || wait $! || exit $?  # stop if the command that made the list failed
           if [ "${#dockerfiles[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
             echo "No Dockerfiles found."

--- a/.github/workflows/prc.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/prc.yml
@@ -43,5 +43,5 @@
         run: |
           set -euo pipefail
-          mapfile -t modules < <(find . -name go.mod \
+          mapfile -t modules < <(set -o pipefail; find . -name go.mod \
             -not -path "./.resource/*" \
             -not -path "./docs/*" \
@@ -53,4 +53,5 @@
               echo "${mod}"
             done)
+          [ -z "$!" ] || wait $! || { __rc=$?; [ "$__rc" -eq 1 ] || exit "$__rc"; }  # stop if the command that made the list failed
           if [ "${#modules[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
             echo "matrix={\"module\":[]}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
